## Summary
Grok through-merge parents still fall back to **parent forge-poll loops** (`gh` check-runs + mergeable_state sleep loops) when `spawn_subagent` Approach 1 babysit is available. That bypasses merge-path arming (`review-monitor:register` + live `pr:watch --monitor-agent-id`) and recreates the unarmed-babysit failure class.

## Observed
Session through-merge cohort (2026-10-18): after rebasing activation PR #5726, parent started a PowerShell forge-poll script instead of dest-placing a babysit worktree and spawning Approach 1. Operator corrected: "you should not poll but use sub agents." Standing rules already require Approach 1 when Tier-1 `spawn_subagent` is available (#4882 / #5219 / review-cycle skill).

## Expected
When Grok Build `spawn_subagent` is available:
1. Parent dest-places a babysit worktree for the PR tip
2. Spawns Approach 1 with `stop-at: CLEAN`, `review-monitor:register --platform-primitive spawn_subagent`, and child `pr:watch --monitor-agent-id`
3. Parent retains squash-merge only after babysitter DONE:CLEAN
4. Parent forge-poll / one-shot `pr:watch` without `--monitor-agent-id` is refused or skill-blocked as unarmed

## Non-goals
- Changing Greptile detection itself
- Removing `pr:watch` (it remains the child live-wait)
- Claiming this closes Windows wrapper / #5656 residuals

## Related
- #4882 merge-path arm / live-wait
- #5219 Approach 1 lease binding
- #5318 cohort review-monitor inventory
- review-cycle skill Review Monitoring

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AGENTS.md / review-cycle / host-grok-build pin: parent forge-poll is ⊗ when `spawn_subagent` is available for Approach 1
- [ ] Through-merge / swarm parent path documents the only lawful waits: Approach 1 child `pr:watch --monitor-agent-id`, or post-CLEAN `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge`
- [ ] Focused regression or skill-contract test/fixture that fails closed on parent-shell poll when Tier-1 stamp proves spawn_subagent
- [ ] CHANGELOG Unreleased note

## Verdict
Prefer-A cannot bind as written: its fixture-only alternative does not substantiate the claim that it closes the observed runtime escape hatch. Keep the explicit prohibition, but either identify and test a bounded production admission path or describe the ship as guidance/contract coverage with the runtime residual still open.

## Verification and existing mechanisms
Read the issue body and only the three envelope comments (Prefer-A 6255151890, Stop 1 6255156756, panel-deposit 6255159160). Re-verified using `git show f51ccc75a4bec440ce43546df8f76de211d514bf:`; no execution fixtures, ingest, occupancy claim, or repository edits.

At that pin:
- `content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/references/host-grok-build.md`, Nested spawn_subagent boundary / Cheapest admitted Approach 1 / Named residual, already makes the parent the closer after CLEAN and excludes parent-shell impersonation. It explicitly leaves ad-hoc TEMP watchers outside the bounded deny.
- `content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md`, Durable live wait, and `AGENTS.md`, Envelope selection SLA, already require the child-bound live wait, lease/heartbeat identity join, and phase-correct closer. Cohort inventory already covers rebase, child exit, and tip churn.
- `packages/core/src/review-monitor/bounded-pr-watch-deny.ts`, `evaluateBoundedPrWatchDeny`, returns `deny: false` for unrecognized commands. Pin-scoped `git grep` finds its production invocation in `packages/core/src/pr-watch/main.ts`; extending that evaluator alone cannot intercept an independent PowerShell/gh watcher.
- `packages/core/src/swarm/approach1-babysitter.ts` already supplies `approach1BabysitterCommands`, `formatApproach1CheapestAdmissionCard`, and capability-stamp support. The command sequence is child register, child watch, then parent verification after the heartbeat is live. These are reusable mechanisms, not new work for this issue.

## F1 — blocks-the-design — A fixture is not admission of the observed shell operation
Evidence: Prefer-A remedy 3 permits a skill-contract test and/or an `evaluateForgePollDeny`-style fixture over a *claimed* wait path, while its opening says this closes the named residual. The pinned bounded evaluator and its production caller cover entry to Directive pr:watch, not entry to the observed standalone poller.

Concrete failure: a fixture refuses `{waitPath: bespoke-temp-poller}` and all content tests pass, while the parent launches exactly the same TEMP PowerShell script outside that evaluator. Even the named Observed class remains executable; disclaiming total arbitrary-shell coverage does not repair this narrower claim.

Disposition: require one named production caller, its observable inputs, the refusal boundary before execution, and one remediation to the existing Approach 1 card. A regression must exercise that caller with the supported observed invocation, not just hand-author the forbidden enum. If host admission is deliberately excluded, retain the runtime residual and narrow P1/P2 relief to guidance; P3/P4 contract coverage can still ship honestly. Do not quietly relabel fixture enforcement as runtime prevention.

Injection/swarm consequence: a parent's declared path, copied monitor id, or a PR comment saying CLEAN is not authority for admission. Reuse the existing capability/session resolution and PR-specific lease/live-heartbeat checks. Bind the caller to the intended repository/worktree and PR; a sibling's fresh stamp or armed PR must not authorize this PR's wait. This is an integration requirement for F1, not a proposed new identity registry. The fixture should include a claimed Approach 1 path without its bound evidence and a different-PR arm as negative cases.

## F2 — sharpens-framing — The premise is already unlawful under the pinned contract
Evidence: Stop 1 refutes the proposition that parent forge-poll is a lawful substitute. The pinned host adapter says parent-retained is the closer after CLEAN, and the review-cycle Durable live wait section already excludes homemade wrappers as arms. AGENTS also prohibits parent babysitting when dispatch is available.

Concrete failure: describing this principally as a missing prohibition encourages another round of MUST text and token-presence tests while reproducing the same enforcement gap. The practical ambiguity is discoverability and omitted admission, not permission granted by the current deep contract.

Disposition: the explicit AGENTS pin remains useful, but state that it reinforces an existing prohibition. Separate that benefit from whatever bounded runtime control is actually shipped. Preserve the existing after-watch verification ordering and current-HEAD recheck after rebase; do not treat historical DONE:CLEAN as permanent permission for the closer.

## F3 — footnote — Panel deposit disagrees with the envelope ceiling
The envelope ceiling is 6255159160, but panel-deposit 6255159160 records `id-ceiling: 6255156756` and repeats that older input ceiling in prose. It also uses seat-families rather than the canonical siblings/input-ceiling fields. I retained the envelope's 6255159160 ceiling and read no sibling posts. Record this deposit defect without re-ceiling this critic run.

## Road not taken
A broader shell-pattern blacklist could catch one spelling of the incident but is easy to evade through wrappers and risks blocking ordinary diagnostic forge reads. The strongest case for the smaller prose-plus-fixture ship is inexpensive reinforcement of an already-correct rule. That case supports a narrowed contract-only claim. Evidence of a real bounded admission caller that refuses the observed invocation would change F1; merely adding a pure predicate would not.
